note: Actions refused whatever the grants, approvals or packet say (plan v2 B4). Read by home_policy.py; Phase 3a moves this file to the repository's policy/ folder and the module loader reads it for every module.

rules.reason: Smoke, carbon monoxide and leak devices are never disabled, muted, snoozed or removed by the assistant. Do it yourself at the device or in its app.
Turning cameras off is an access action: only with your live approval in Telegram, never from a packet, schedule or incoming event.
